message:
test(apk-0232 E1): scroll_shimmer -- the phone's final output recorded while the picture scrolls, for a person to look at

Codex codex_apk0232_evidence_final.md (NEEDS_EVIDENCE: a controlled scroll's continuous final output). Harness only,
no product change (the candidate APK as shipped).
- sh_pattern_window.ps1 -ScrollFile/-ScrollPx (layered only): while the flag file exists the whole content (thin
  text, 1-px lines, checkerboard...) scrolls up 4 px per 33 ms tick; every pushed picture carries its number (6
  digits + 16 stripes, bottom right) and is logged "scroll frame=n offset ms" ([Console]::Out -- an event handler's
  Write-Output never reached stdout).
- scenario scroll_shimmer: one connection, 끄기 / 약하게 0.20 / 강하게 0.60 (A) / 화면 크기 (실험) 0.60 (B via the
  settings); each: 4 s of adb screenrecord (shimmer_<seg>.mp4), two stills 0.3 s apart while still scrolling, one
  after, the source frame range and the app's drawing-path log -> shimmer_summary.json. Judged only as 'recorded
  while it scrolled' (mp4, frame range, the output moving between the stills) -- the look is a person's to judge.
Candidate 1a3eee63: 6/6 (frames 1-184 / 185-374 / 375-545 / 546-742, ~28 fps source).
